extracted: Arkell is described as a 14-person study, but Table 1 says three did not complete (one withdrawal, one non-compliance, one discharge for raised blood pressure and heart rate). The review reports anxiety raised at 15 minutes with both active conditions and at one hour only with THC alone, and DSST impairment at 20 minutes versus placebo only with THC alone. A difference in significance does not itself establish a significant active-treatment difference. The divided-attention result explicitly compares THC with CBD against THC alone and placebo. Outcome-specific analysis denominators are not established from the review.
